# Independent NTFS fixture

`ntfs-testfs1.img` is the published 2 MiB testfs1 image from ColinFinck/ntfs.
Source: https://github.com/ColinFinck/ntfs/tree/master/testdata
Generation script: https://github.com/ColinFinck/ntfs/blob/master/testdata/create-testfs1.sh
SHA-256: e3612c182b8010e3599b5eb93bff427c7d824e85bdc2ddbe46e378e3ba814eb9
Retrieved: 2026-10-26. License: included MIT notice.

The independent generator uses mkntfs/ntfs-3g. Expected file contents are stated
by that script, rather than generated by DaemonCore's parser implementation.
Tests read it as evidence and never mount or alter it. It validates resident,
nonresident, and sparse reads from an independently formatted NTFS volume.
It does not establish deleted-file recovery accuracy on arbitrary real disks.
